items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I had the band in with Punch and Herman Cham was still there and myself. ... He was playing first trumpet

ctx.x: Did you know Punch Miller here in town? When he was here in the 20s?
Oh, Punch came here around 58. Mm-hmm. And Punch told me, he said that Punch was stopping down at Page Hotel.
